$comment: SpecSelf Starter — Claude Code settings. SessionStart computes per-tier overdue (weekly/monthly/quarterly/annual) from your-life/reviews/ filenames and prints one line per tier that's overdue; it stays silent when everything is current, and it only prints — it never writes a review. PreToolUse runs the privacy guard before any git commit/push and BLOCKS it when the change includes private your-life/ corpus or a secret — your life stays yours. The guard checks paths, so editing .gitignore does not bypass it; its agent-independent twin is the pre-commit hook (.pre-commit-config.yaml). Remove either block freely.
